svg.text: Azure Netbench Low-Level Benchmark Execution Flow
End-to-end execution: staggered Ubuntu 24.04 Spot VMs, IMDS token exchange, NSG-gated qperf/iperf3 sweeps & Private Link POST
Stage 1 — Staggered VM Provisioning & Cloud-Init Daemons (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Noble Gen2)
Sweeps az1, az2, az3 at t = 0s
Sweeps az1, az2, az3 at t = +60s
Sweeps az1, az2, az3 at t = +120s
Up to 12 attempts (5s backoff) via curl + jq
Stage 5 — Persisted Table Entity Schema & Dashboard API Normalization (/api/data)
Graceful sample fallback when storage env unset
Loads 30d by default; fetches ?window=all on All Time
One-click CSV export of filtered series
